strategyPoints: Tire wear will be a major factor on this South Course. Managing the rubber through the esses is key to a strong finish.
With the shorter lap length, fuel strategy will be tight. Every drop counts on this 2.5 kilometer layout.
The pit window is relatively short on the South Course. A quick stop is essential for maintaining track position.
The balance between straight-line speed and cornering grip is crucial here. Teams will be making compromises in their setup.
Overcut or undercut? With the compact nature of the track, a well-timed pit stop could be the difference between winning and losing.
Track position is vital on the South Course. Overtaking can be difficult, so getting ahead early is crucial.
The warm-up of the tires will be critical, especially early in the race. The esses will punish cold tires.
The shorter lap means more traffic. Navigating the slower cars will be a key element of the race strategy.
